name: Umesh Chandra Mohapatra

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Umesh Chandra Mohapatra writes poetry in Odia and English. Panchayat College, Bargarh, lists him under the spelling Umesh Chandra Mahapatra in its English department, with comparative literature among his specialisms. The college also records his doctoral research on human relationships in Sarojini Naidu's poetry. This connection between literary study and the textures of human life offers a useful approach to his work here.

His Odia poems repeatedly set possession against a larger, less measurable world. Bargaphut Bilasa turns a carefully acquired apartment into a question about enclosure and lost neighbourliness, while Akashara Hasa contrasts human acquisitiveness with the quiet openness of sky and flowers. Muhurte Mrutyu Saha answers death with maternal affection, literature and art; Anya Akasha allows the world's mystery to remain, rather than forcing it into explanation.
